pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that all rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
The 'AC-2' test checks / and /?view=open list only open items in id order.
The 'AC-3' test marks items 3 and 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.

The code does implement it, and an unnamed test checks it. The last commit (078e0713, 'Follow-up edits') renamed the test from 'AC-4: …' to 'the all view lists…'. No test now names AC-4, and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'. Under the naming rule the item is unmet.
The 'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view, with the current view in <strong> and not a link.
The 'AC-6' test checks 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, empty and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
The 'AC-7' test covers Nothing open, Nothing done yet, and No items yet. in all three views of an empty table.
traffic/routes.json lists both views. The 'AC-8' test checks them. The traffic-config checker was widened to accept queries, and tests/traffic-config.test.sh covers that.

findings.what: The final commit 'Follow-up edits' removed 'AC-4' from the all-view test title. No test names AC-4 any more, so the item has no named proof. The commit message does not mention it.
findings.fix: Restore 'AC-4:' in the test title (or in its body).

findings.what: The PR says test/done.test.js 'covers AC-1 to AC-8'. Since the last commit no test names AC-4, so the claim is no longer true of the final tree.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-4 test name, or correct the claim.

findings.what: The README's description of src/index.js does not mention that an invalid view returns 400. The PR body does mention it.
findings.fix: Add a short note on the 400 for an unknown view.

findings.what: I could not run the tests. npm test failed with 'vitest: not found' because dependencies are not installed in this copy.
findings.fix: Run npm install and then npm test in CI.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec and its recorded go. The only gap is the AC-4 naming.
7 of 8 items are met. AC-4 is unmet because its test lost the AC-4 name in the last commit. All six rows of the state table have a test.
The assertions check behaviour. The fake app in test/traffic.test.js was extended and nothing was loosened. Tests could not be run here because vitest is not installed.
The README was updated for the views. It omits the 400 case.
The view lookup uses Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragments come from a fixed table, so no user input reaches the query. The empty-table check runs a separate COUNT query. I found no defects.
The view value is allowlisted, titles are escaped, and the SQL is not built from input. No planted instructions found.
The page is minimal server-rendered HTML with no UI framework or style files. The nav and view-state markup is covered by the code and tests lenses.
